groups.why_chosen: STRAW tracks a read counter per block and per wordline; every interval it checks each wordline's accumulated disturbance against a threshold, relocates the valid pages of any heavily-disturbed wordline, and erases the block once nothing valid remains.
groups.what_to_learn: One fill colour per functional stage; `Y`/`N` on every branch; a labelled loop box containing its own decision
